details.description: Gatorade Blue Bolt Zero Sugar is the ultimate sports drink for those seeking optimal hydration without the extra calories. Scientifically formulated with fluids, electrolytes, carbohydrates, and a refreshing flavour, this beverage is designed to rehydrate, replenish, and refuel your body during exercise. Packed with an energising burst, it revitalises and recharges, making it the perfect choice for anyone on the go. The formula provides the same great taste and performance benefits you expect from Gatorade, but with none of the sugar or excess calories. Whether you're an athlete, an active individual, or simply looking to stay hydrated throughout the day, Gatorade Blue Bolt Zero Sugar is the ideal solution to rehydrate, boost energy levels, and enhance workout recovery.
